customPatterns.title: Custom log formats and highlighting
customPatterns.description: Paste <LogParsingPattern …/> and <LogHighlightingPattern …/> elements from an Ideolog settings export or the Ideolog custom log formats wiki (github.com/JetBrains/ideolog/wiki/Custom-Log-Formats). Colours map to the nearest theme colour; HIDE patterns are ignored. An open log picks up changes when it is edited or reopened.
